activity.notes: The Civ mod's leader 'Liu' is Empress Liu E (Empress Zhangxian Mingsu). After Emperor Zhenzong's death in 1022 she governed as empress dowager and regent for the young Renzong until her death in 1033. She was not a Song emperor in her own right.

sources.title: Chronicles of Changes: The Transforming Image of Empress Liu in the Northern Song [1033-1089] — University of Virginia
sources.citation_text: The University of Virginia history thesis identifies Empress Liu (969–1033) as the first Song empress regent and gives her regency as 1022–1033.
